name: Sareser
title: Sanherib's Son and Murderer
summary: Sareser was one of the sons of the Assyrian king Sanherib. Together with his brother Adrammelek, he killed his father while he was worshiping in his god's temple, and they then fled to the land of Ararat. This event fulfilled God's judgment against Sanherib after his mockery of Israel's God.

keyEvents.title: Sanherib's Mockery of God
keyEvents.description: Sareser's father Sanherib sent threatening letters and messengers to King Hezekiah in Jerusalem and mocked the living God.

keyEvents.title: God's Judgment on the Assyrian Army
keyEvents.description: The angel of the Lord struck down 185,000 men in the Assyrian camp, forcing Sanherib to retreat to Nineveh.

keyEvents.title: The Murder of Sanherib
keyEvents.description: Sarezer and his brother Adrammelech killed their father Sennacherib with the sword while he was worshiping in the temple of Nisroch, his god, in Nineveh.

keyEvents.title: Flight to the Land of Ararat
keyEvents.description: After killing their father, Sarezer and Adrammelech fled to the land of Ararat, and their brother Esarhaddon became king instead.

keyEvents.title: Fulfillment of Isaiah's Prophecy
keyEvents.description: The killing of Sennacherib was a fulfillment of the prophet Isaiah's words that God would protect Jerusalem and judge the Assyrian king.
